name: Bloom
long_description:
Bloom is the brand layer for agents - it turns brand into infrastructure that any agent, app, or platform can call.

Ingest your brand from anywhere - decks, websites, social, Figma, and more.
Bloom systemises your brand, enabling the creation of on-brand outputs like images, video, video, copy, and more, through the web app, the API, or MCP.

We're building brand-as-infrastructure for the AI era.

launches.title: Bloom – the brand layer for agents
launches.tagline: Bloom turns brand into infrastructure that any agent, app, or platform can call.
launches.body:
**Bloom — the brand layer for agents**

AI has unlocked an abundance of software. But software is just one input into building a product and running a business - and as it's gotten cheap and fast, new limiting factors have emerged. Brand is one of them. Unlike software, brand isn't operable: it's scattered across decks, products, and tribal knowledge. There’s no _system_ for brand, and nothing can actually _call_ it, and so most of what gets shipped is off-brand by default.

We think brand is becoming infrastructure: one canonical source of truth that any system can query. Bloom is that brand layer - we’re creating the systems to make brand as wieldable as code.\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CpmsCzswCSY>

**How it works**

1. **Ingest.** Point Bloom at everything that defines your brand: website, decks, Figma, socials, codebases, and more.
2. **Systemise.** Bloom unifies it into one brand system - a canonical ontology of your brand.
3. **Deploy anywhere.** Call that system from every surface and generate every asset you need - ads, social, product shots, mockups, and full campaigns.

**Built for agents** \
Bloom is designed to be used by agents, rather than humans. The primitives (API, MCP, and soon CLI) have excellent _agent ergonomics_ making your brand callable from everywhere:

* **Agents:** marketing agents running campaigns, coding agents creating landing pages, e-commerce agents running brands - all calling Bloom over MCP.
* **Products:** use our API as the brand layer for any products that require brand context or assets for their customers.
* **Brand and marketing operations:** agencies and marketing teams call Bloom to automate on-brand asset creation inside their existing stack.
* **Claude:** use the Claude connector to create on-brand assets with all of your existing context.

**Traction** - We launched v1 in December and went [viral](https://x.com/rincidium/status/1995946528343818656?s=20). Since then we’ve generated over 175,000 on-brand assets for our customers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102368&key=user_uploads/2440455/ad3ce037-7d78-4314-984d-80ca741181e8)

**Our ask**

We'd love to hear from:

* **Agents and product builders** who leverage brand context or need to produce on-brand assets.
* **Brands and agencies** running marketing at scale

Reach out: [ray@trybloom.ai](mailto:ray@trybloom.ai)

Try it: [trybloom.ai](http://trybloom.ai)
